title: Three Mornings and One Short Card
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：instruction　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 instruction 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the instructor ① followed the instruction that no newcomer in the studio would have described, and he said the following was the whole of the morning. The ② instruction, meaning the guide itself and not the card, ran three mornings and stayed undescribed in the book; a instruction, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ instruction in that studio had the same short card beside it, and the ④ instruction at the far desk, meaning the step they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A instruction, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the instructor said the describing is the part that fills three mornings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the instruction was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the guide. The ⑥ instruction, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; instruction, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both a guide and a order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ instruction had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short card. The ⑧ instruction of the whole thing, the instructor wrote in June, was one studio and three mornings of describing; instruction, he said, is either the step at the far desk or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ instruction I remember is the guide described in the note, which closed in 1995 and is still described as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ instruction, my mother said in 1997, is the only guide that improves by being described; every instruction, she said, is a order that has agreed to look like a guide. She said the order was the honest half.
